array.string: e="$(readlink -e /zf-golden/.zenoforge/engine-live 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$e" ]; then export ZF_ENGINE_DIR="$e" ZF_ENGINE_LIVE="$e"; [ -z "${ZF_PACK_DIR-}" ] || export ZF_PACK_DIR="$e"; for v in ZF_RELEASE_TRAIN_SCRIPT AGENT_INCIDENT_GUARDS_FILE ZF_PRODUCTION_TENANT_MARKER_EXCEPTIONS_FILE; do p="${!v-}"; case "$p" in /zf-golden/.zenoforge/engine-live/*) export "$v=$e/${p#/zf-golden/.zenoforge/engine-live/}";; esac; done; fi; exec "${e:-/zf-golden/.zenoforge/checkout/engine}/run-tick.sh"
